faqs.q: What are the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters set and show the oil flow to each point of an oil circulating system. A spring-loaded float with an integral magnet rises in a glass tube with the flow, the needle valve sets it, and a switch contact can signal low flow. See the [oil circulation systems](/c/oil-circulation-systems) shelf for related equipment.

faqs.q: What models and sizes are in the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters range?
faqs.a: The range lists 18 part numbers. DVA manifold flowmeters carry up to 6 outlets and 24 L/min in total, and DVU individual flowmeters cover 11 ranges from 0.1 to 80 L/min per outlet.

faqs.q: How do I select from the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters range?
faqs.a: Choose a DVA manifold when one block should serve several points and a DVU where each point needs its own meter and range, then match the flow range, the thread (BSP or NPT) and the oil. Size the circuit on the oil flow the bearings or gears need.

faqs.q: What pressure and output do the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters have?
faqs.a: Maximum pressure is 174 psi (12 bar) to 232 psi (16 bar), depending on the part number, and the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters are listed for oil. The flow range is set per meter, from 0.1 to 80 L/min per outlet on the DVU.

faqs.q: How do I order a part number from the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters range?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number, for example IH-BD-DVA01A00000100 (DVA01A00000100, FLOWMETER 1BANK ADJ 12L/MIN) or IH-BD-DVU02A00000600 (DVU02A00000600, FLOWMETER 2BANK 3-15L/MIN SW). The Bijur Delimon DVA datasheet is in the Downloads tab.

faqs.q: Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters or Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters monitor the flow to individual points, while the OCS units are the circulating, filtering and cooling package that supplies the oil. See the [Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems](/p/bijur-delimon-ocs-oil-circulating-systems) for its own ratings.

faqs.q: What lubricants can the Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters be used with?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon DVA and DVU Oil Flowmeters are listed for oil, with BSP and NPT threads and the oil in connection on 1/2BSPP. The viscosity and outlet thread for each part number are in the size table; outlet threads include 3/4BSPP, 1/2BSPP and 1/4BSPP.

faqs.q: What are the Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems are standard multi-purpose units that circulate, filter and cool oil for the lubrication of bearings, gear trains and other oil-cooled processes, for jobs where a custom design is not needed. See the [oil circulation systems](/c/oil-circulation-systems) shelf for related equipment.

faqs.q: What models and sizes are in the Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems range?
faqs.a: The range lists 38 part numbers, with reservoirs from 12 to 600 L and outputs of 5LPM, 10LPM, 15LPM, 20LPM, 30LPM and 4 more. Units are listed by reservoir, pump flow, motor power, number of pumps, simplex or duplex filter, connections and size.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems?
faqs.a: Size the unit on the oil flow the bearings or gears need, the heat to be removed and the oil grade, then the filtration (simplex or duplex for change-over without shutdown), cooling, heating for cold starts and the flow monitoring at each point. For a custom system we send Bijur Delimon's OCS request form.

faqs.q: What are the ratings and output of the Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems?
faqs.a: Maximum pressure is 130 psi (9 bar) to 160 psi (11 bar), on 230/480VAC supply, with an IP67 rating listed and an operating temperature of 5°C-40°C. The listed oil range is 20-1500 cSt.

faqs.q: What do I quote to order from the Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems range?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number, for example IH-BD-OCS-XG02510 (OCS 25L 1/2 5LPM SIMPLEX-FL, 0.37 kW, 1 pump, simplex filter) or IH-BD-OCS-XG05020 (OCS 50L 1/2 5LPM DUPLEX-FL, duplex filter). The Bijur Delimon recirculation systems brochure is in the Downloads tab.

faqs.q: How do the Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems differ from the Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems circulate, filter and cool the oil as a package, while the OCS shell-and-tube heat exchangers cool oil in an oil circulating system. See the [Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers](/p/bijur-delimon-ocs-shell-and-tube-heat-exchangers) for its own ratings.

faqs.q: What lubricants can the Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems be used with?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems are listed for oil of 20-1500 cSt. Options include removable heaters with PT100, a wired junction box, a pressure switch and flowmeters, and the outlet threads are 1/8NPT or 1/4BSPP.

faqs.q: What are the Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers are three-pass shell-and-tube heat exchangers that cool the oil in an oil circulating system. Three passes dissipate more heat with less water, and the floating tube stack is removable for cleaning. See the [oil circulation systems](/c/oil-circulation-systems) shelf for related equipment.

faqs.q: What models and sizes are in the Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers range?
faqs.a: The range lists 4 part numbers: OF04SP-A1 (3 kW heat dissipation) and three OCS heat-exchanger-with-thermostat units for 5, 5-40 and 50 L/min.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers?
faqs.a: Size the exchanger on the oil flow, the heat to be removed and the oil grade, then pick the OF04SP-A1 by its 3 kW heat dissipation or the thermostat units by flow: 5LPM, 5-40LPM or 50LPM.

faqs.q: What pressure and output do the Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers have?
faqs.a: OF04SP-A1 is listed at 3 kW heat dissipation, and the thermostat units at 5LPM, 5-40LPM and 50LPM. They are hydraulically tested and CE-rated, as the manufacturer states.

faqs.q: What do I quote to order from the Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers range?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number, for example IH-BD-OF04SP-A1 (OF04SP-A1, 3 kW heat dissipation) or IH-BD-OCS-XG0005 (OCS HEAT-EXCHGR+THERMO 50LPM). The Bijur Delimon heat exchanger datasheet is in the Downloads tab.

faqs.q: Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers or Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers only cool the oil, while the OCS oil circulating systems circulate, filter and cool it in one unit. See the [Bijur Delimon OCS Oil Circulating Systems](/p/bijur-delimon-ocs-oil-circulating-systems) for its own ratings.

faqs.q: What lubricant or media does the Bijur Delimon OCS Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers handle?
